verdict.rationale: Metronome is a billing SaaS whose operations can be driven headlessly through its own REST API. That API uses bearer-token auth, official SDKs in five languages, built-in idempotency for safe retries, and a published OpenAPI spec, so scripted automation without the UI is documented. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline usage, or CI-specific credentials, and API tokens are created through the Metronome app. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/CD integration guidance or examples, programmatic token provisioning for CI, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Metronome’s API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests.
The SDKs for Python, Go, Ruby, Node.js, and Java offer developers flexible options for implementing Metronome's capabilities across platforms and environments.
Metronome provides built-in idempotency mechanisms so you can safely retry requests without introducing extraneous data.
Use the Metronome API to manage your customer's subscription lifecycle including pricing changes, free trials, upgrades, and downgrades.
